llm.summary: The skill's files, commands, and env usage are internally consistent with a local browser-extension collection tool; it requires curl/node and runs a local bridge or remote SSH-executed collector as described.

dimensions.detail: Name/description (browser plugin collection + Feishu export) match the provided scripts and SKILL.md: scripts call a local bridge API (/api/collect, /api/status, /api/tasks), use curl/node, and provide options for export and polling. Required binaries (curl, node) are appropriate for the stated functionality.
dimensions.label: Purpose & Capability
dimensions.name: purpose_capability

dimensions.detail: Runtime instructions keep to the bridge API and the bundled scripts. They explicitly tell the agent to start the included run.sh / collect_and_export_loop.sh and to interact with localhost:19820. The SKILL.md discourages running file-discovery commands before execution (performance guidance) — unusual but not malicious. The scripts will start a bridge process (via a user-supplied --bridge-cmd) and may tail logs; they do not attempt to read unrelated system files or exfiltrate data to unknown remote endpoints themselves.
dimensions.label: Instruction Scope
dimensions.name: instruction_scope

dimensions.detail: No install spec (instruction-only) and included scripts are executed directly. Nothing is downloaded from external URLs; no archive extraction. Risk is limited to executing the provided scripts on the host.
dimensions.label: Install Mechanism
dimensions.name: install_mechanism

dimensions.detail: The skill declares no required env vars but the scripts reference several optional environment variables (WEB_COLLECTION_BRIDGE_URL, WEB_COLLECTION_REMOTE_SSH, WEB_COLLECTION_LOCAL_WORKDIR, etc.). This is proportionate — they are optional configuration points — but the agent or user must be careful: setting WEB_COLLECTION_REMOTE_SSH causes ssh to be invoked and will run the collector on a remote host.
dimensions.label: Credentials
dimensions.name: environment_proportionality

dimensions.detail: always:false and no permanent privilege escalation. The skill does not modify other skills or system-wide agent configs. It can execute remote commands via SSH only if environment is configured to do so (an explicit behavior of run.sh).
dimensions.label: Persistence & Privilege
dimensions.name: persistence_privilege

llm.guidance:
This skill appears to do what it says: run the bundled scripts to drive a local browser-extension bridge and export results. Before installing or running it, review and consider:
- Only run these scripts if you have the browser extension and bridge code from a trusted source. The bridge/extension perform the actual scraping and export (e.g., to Feishu) and may hold credentials/permissions in the browser extension.
- The scripts can start an arbitrary bridge command you provide (--bridge-cmd). Do not pass untrusted commands or remote paths that could execute malicious code.
- If WEB_COLLECTION_REMOTE_SSH is set, the skill will ssh to that host and execute the collector there. Only set that to a trusted host you control; otherwise you risk running remote commands on an unintended machine.
- The tool communicates with localhost:19820 by default. Verify the bridge-server.js and any extension code to ensure exported data destinations (Feishu callbacks, table URLs) are acceptable.
- Run the scripts under a non-root account and inspect the bridge/extension source before use. If you want higher assurance, run them in an isolated VM or container and audit the bridge-server and extension code.
